limitations: External SMTP, external CAPTCHA, production activation/PKI and MySQL8 are not accepted by this slice.
ArrayTransport success records local message execution, not external delivery.
No business idempotency or automatic retry. False cache put, late exception, audit failure and lost/deadline reply can leave unknown mail/code state; native behavior is preserved.
Trusted in-process listeners/plugins own logging remains outside the diagnostic guarantee.
Full Core/Gateway/Node B5/B6/B8 completion is not claimed by this slice.
